title: Reservation Type Schedule — Deposits and Payment Timing (Pre-Orders & Back-Orders)
content:
Pre-Orders & Back-Orders reservations are paid for in one of three ways, and the way depends only on the reservation type. The schedule below sets, for each of the six types, the deposit figures, when the card is charged or authorized, how long a customer has to update a declined card, and what is collected when the item ships.

| | Standard Back-Order | Supplier Direct Back-Order | Seasonal Pre-Order | Launch Pre-Order | Deposit Pre-Order | Made-to-Order Reservation |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Deposit percentage of the reserved price | 0 (no deposit) | 0 (no deposit) | 0 (no deposit) | 0 (no deposit) | 20 | 50 |
| Minimum deposit when a deposit applies | $0.00 | $0.00 | $0.00 | $0.00 | $25.00 | $50.00 |
| Tenders that can pay a deposit | Card or wallet | Card or wallet | Card or wallet | Card or wallet | Card or wallet | Card or wallet |
| Rounding of the deposit | Half up to the cent | Half up to the cent | Half up to the cent | Half up to the cent | Half up to the cent | Half up to the cent |
| When the customer pays | Charged at shipment | Charged at shipment | Charged at shipment | Card authorized at reservation, captured at shipment | Deposit at reservation, balance at shipment | Deposit at reservation, balance at shipment |
| What a reservation-time authorization covers | Not applicable | Not applicable | Not applicable | Unit price times quantity, plus estimated tax | Not applicable | Not applicable |
| Authorization renewed after (calendar days) | 0 (none) | 0 (none) | 0 (none) | 7 | 0 (none) | 0 (none) |
| Hours to update a declined card | 48 | 48 | 48 | 24 | 48 | 48 |
| Charged at shipment | Final price | Final price | Final price | Final price | Final price less the deposit | Final price less the deposit |
| Amount due at shipment paid on a fulfilment order accepting all order tenders | Yes | Yes | Yes | No | Yes | Yes |

**Reading the schedule**

- A deposit percentage of 0 means the type takes no deposit; its minimum deposit is then $0.00. Only the Deposit Pre-Order (20 percent, never less than $25.00) and the Made-to-Order Reservation (50 percent, never less than $50.00) carry a deposit.
- Deposits are card-only: the tender listed for a deposit is the card or wallet on the customer's account.
- The hours to update a declined card run from the decline. A Launch Pre-Order has 24 hours; every other type has 48 hours.
- The 7-day renewal applies to the one type that holds a card authorization from the moment of reservation, the Launch Pre-Order. The other types hold no authorization, which the schedule shows as 0.
- "Final price less the deposit" means that the deposit already paid counts towards the price when the item ships. "Final price" means the whole price is collected at shipment.

**Points of comparison**

| Question | Answer from the schedule |
|---|---|
| Which types charge nothing until the item ships? | Standard Back-Order, Supplier Direct Back-Order and Seasonal Pre-Order |
| Which type touches the card at reservation without taking money? | Launch Pre-Order: it authorizes the card for unit price times quantity plus estimated tax |
| Which types take money at reservation? | Deposit Pre-Order and Made-to-Order Reservation |
| Which type's amount due at shipment is not paid on a fulfilment order that accepts all order tenders? | Launch Pre-Order |
